scope: Logical R5-to-R3 descriptor-durability prerequisite contract only. No Chisel carrier behavior, descriptor write, R1 request, metadata publication, authority transfer, physical descriptor storage, HBM/controller behavior, timing, throughput, PPA, model/GPU, RTL correctness, or new A4 DSE claim.

bits.name: tail_link
bits.required_rule: required exactly when the matching R5 allocation requires_tail_link

result_type.name: DescriptorDurabilityPrerequisite
producer_owns: requires_tail_link determination from its matching allocation
one final aggregate result per live append association
consumer_owns: match to current P3 stage/group association
neither_owns: R1 request identity or terminal status creation

success_rule.mask_rule: durable_descriptor_operation_mask == required_descriptor_operation_mask and required mask includes new_page
success_rule.effect: R3 may record only the matching private descriptor-durability prerequisite; this is necessary but insufficient for metadata_publish_commit

fault_rule.effect: R5 retains fail-closed private fault association and R3 marks only the matching group non-publishable; no retry, fallback, visibility, authority transfer, page free, or second terminal path
fault_rule.one_way_rule: a faulted association cannot later emit successful descriptor_prepared without explicit cleanup or destructive reset

ordering_and_acceptance: R5 allocation fixes page_ref, generation, layer, kv_head, transaction_group_tag, and whether tail_link is required
only exact accepted final DescriptorMaintenanceTerminal facts contribute to R5 durable mask
R5 emits one aggregate prerequisite only after every required operation has either become durable or a fault has terminalized the association
R3 accepts only a matching result for its current private P3 stage/group/page association
R3 must have accepted an exact success prerequisite before it may accept the existing metadata publish request for that association
successful prerequisite does not itself emit metadata_publish_visibility_apply, M2 visibility, lifecycle authority transition, P3 release, or source deliverability
the existing nested R3-to-R5 metadata_publish_visibility_apply/ack remains inside the one metadata_publish_commit boundary

rejection_and_stall.ready_low_rule: while result valid is high and R3 ready is low, every result field and both owners' prerequisite/publication state remain unchanged

excluded_paths: R3 reconstruction from payload durable or allocation alone
R5 allocator free or generation reuse
R2 scheduler or R1 memory path

required_follow_on.requires: Add the exact R5-to-R3 decoupled carrier and bind R3 publish acceptance to the accepted success prerequisite; preserve the existing nested visibility apply/ack rather than replacing it.
required_follow_on.not_authorized: No descriptor maintenance behavior, P3 payload behavior, publication behavior, physical descriptor realization, controller behavior, timing, throughput, PPA, or performance result.
